caption:
What did Fianna Fáil TDs speak about most often in the Dáil?

Across 8,421 classified speech records from current Fianna Fáil TDs, the most frequent issue category was Housing and Community Development, followed by Health and Education.

Coverage: 18 Dec 2024–26 Feb 2026. Counts show classified speech frequency, not party policy, priority or position.

Source: Houses of the Oireachtas data, classified by Eirepolitic.

alt_text.cover: Fianna Fáil in the Dáil. 48 current TDs and 8,421 classified speeches, with debate coverage from 18 December 2024 to 26 February 2026.
alt_text.issue_profile: Horizontal bar chart showing the seven most frequent classified issue categories in Dáil speeches by current Fianna Fáil TDs from 18 December 2024 to 26 February 2026: Housing and Community Development (1,286), Health (1,135), Education (920), Law/Crime and Family Issues (630), Transportation (571), Government Operations (549), International Affairs and Foreign Aid (542).

source_note: Houses of the Oireachtas / Eirepolitic classification
method_note: Counts represent classified speech frequency by current TDs; they do not represent party policy, priority or position.
